_method: CIC IoT-DIAD 2024 packet-based release ('Device Identification_Anomaly Detection - Packet Based Features'). For each listed file the first bytes_read bytes were streamed through the dataset portal (no download) and, for every packet whose src_ip is in 192.168.137.0/24, the triple (src_ip, src_mac as released, eth_src_oui) was counted. The release replaces src_mac of catalogued testbed devices by the device name. Read 2026-11-12.
